outputComponents.text:
I have designed and implemented the **/requests** page for the PSF Request Portal following the NXP-inspired redesign specifications in **DESIGN.md** for the **Requester** role on **Mobile** (with responsive desktop support).

### Summary of What Was Delivered

1. **Page Purpose & Context:**
   - Route `/requests` rendered as the shared catalog of submitted requests for Requesters and Setup Owners.
   - Header with title **Requests**, subtitle *"Browse shared PSF requests."*, and distinct scope note *"• Private drafts are in My Drafts"*.
   - Standalone **New Request** action linking to `/requests/new` for initial draft creation. No KPI summary tiles or department scope dropdowns were copied from the Dashboard.

2. **Mobile Navigation & Header Shell:**
   - Sticky top bar with 44px touch targets: Menu button, compact **PSF Request Portal** brand mark, interactive Theme Toggle (Switch to dark/light mode), and Sam Taylor avatar (`ST`).
   - Operable sliding navigation drawer with Backdrop, Close button (`aria-label="Close navigation menu"`), and exact routes:
     - **Dashboard** (`/dashboard`)
     - **Requests** (`/requests`, marked `aria-current="page"` and active)
     - **My Drafts** (`/my-drafts`)
     - **Audit History** (`/history` — included for authenticated roles)
     - **Export** (`/admin/export-profile`)
   - Drawer footer displaying user identity: **Sam Taylor**, `Requester · Systems Eng`.

3. **Search, Status & Product Type Filters:**
   - Persistent keyword search with placeholder `"Search request no., title, PSF or probecard"`.
   - Collapsible **Filters** disclosure control opening the read-only **Status** dropdown and **Product type** text input with a **Clear filters** action without creating horizontal overflow.
   - Exact catalog containing **"All statuses"** plus all **16 non-draft database statuses** decoded verbatim, including the exact 71-character double-backslash string:
     `93% -- Provide test template map to EWFM\Update auto FI script (ST Fab)`

4. **Five Illustrative Sample Rows in Specified Order:**
   - **S32K3 probe layout update** (`PSF-2026-0042` · `New Product`): `20% -- PSF File Creating` (open badge), `01 Oct 2026` (`OVERDUE`, `High`), Alex Morgan / Mei Tan / MFG.
   - **ST Fab template map review** (`PSF-2026-0039` · `Transfer Product`): full `93%` status text with natural multi-line wrapping, `06 Oct 2026` (`Normal`), Priya Rao / Rowan Miller / GNTC.
   - **Wafer map site verification** (`PSF-2026-0035` · `Existing Product`): `99% -- Wait requestor Buyoff site location and wafer map` (open badge), `08 Oct 2026` (`Normal`), Alex Morgan / Mei Tan / MFG.
   - **Probe pattern release** (`PSF-2026-0028` · `New Product`): `100% -- Completed` (completed green badge), `02 Oct 2026` (`Normal`), Jordan Lee / Rowan Miller / GNTC.
   - **Cancelled layout request** (`PSF-2026-0019` · `Existing Product`): `0% -- Rejected (Cancel Request)` (cancelled neutral badge), `09 Oct 2026` (`Normal`), Priya Rao / Mei Tan / MFG.

5. **List / Card Transformation & Responsive Pagination:**
   - On mobile, renders as vertical touch-friendly cards containing the four data groups (Request, Status, Schedule, Responsibility); on desktop viewports, automatically renders the four-column table.
   - Footer shows `"Showing 1–5 of 5 requests"` with disabled Previous and Next controls (`Page 1 of 1`).
   - Includes real inline JavaScript for theme switching (`data-theme="light"` / `data-theme="dark"`), drawer interaction, filter disclosure, and live filtering across the 5 sample records with an empty state.
